name: Products Display Lite for Magento
author: mywpplugin

sections.description:
Products Display Lite for Magento allows you to easily display product information from your Magento store using a simple shortcode. Customize the product display to suit your needs with attributes like SKU, domain, language, and more.

Key Features:
* Display products using a shortcode with various attributes
* Customize the product appearance: SKU, description length, price visibility, and more
* Easy configuration through a settings page
* Simple integration with your Magento store
* Multilingual support through language codes
* Flexible pricing display options

Want more features? Upgrade to the PRO version and unlock the ability to add products to Elementor and Gutenberg with advanced settings and customization.

Upgrade to PRO for more features:
* Elementor and Gutenberg integration
* Advanced styling options with presets
* Built-in caching system for improved performance
* Customizable layouts and designs

Buy the PRO version now to get the full capabilities!

Support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/products-display-lite-for-magento directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ -> ‘Products Display Lite for Magento’ to set up your access token and Magento domain.
sections.faq:
Do I need Magento access credentials?

Yes, you need an access token from your Magento store to use this plugin.

Can I customize the product display?

Yes, you can customize the product display through shortcode attributes.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

The plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme that follows WordPress coding standards.

Can I display multiple products?

Yes, you can use the shortcode multiple times on any page or post to display different products.

How do I get support?

For support inquiries, please visit our website at myaiplugins.com.
